forgot.subtitle: Enter the email you signed up with and we'll send you a link to set a new password.

hub.addHint: The address of the Chordia server you want to sign in to. Its website address is fine. Ask whoever runs it if you are not sure.
hub.chooseFirst: Choose a server to sign in to.
hub.insecureBody: {url} uses plain HTTP, so your sign-in and everything you listen to travel across the network unencrypted. Only continue on a network you trust.
hub.insecureRefused: This build only connects to https:// servers, so your sign-in never travels in clear text.
hub.invalidUrl: That does not look like a web address.
hub.isWebApp: That address is the Chordia web app, not the server behind it. They are usually on different addresses: try the one whoever runs it gave you, which is often the same host on a different port.
hub.label: Server
hub.labelHint: Optional, and only on this computer. Useful when several servers answer to the same name.
hub.removeBody: Removes {name} from this app and signs you out of it here. Nothing on the server itself changes.
hub.unreachable: No Chordia server answered at that address.
